private_wrapper_delegates.signature_contract: Exactly one function per base and delegate; delegate identity argument types, argument names/defaults and result match its source function. Original function name remains present with guarded body and prior ACL.

private_account_delegates.signature_contract: Same identity arguments/defaults/result as original; original guarded functions remain. decide_account delegate calls private configure/approve delegates.

new_tables.owner_note: Policy role is migration current_user; documented disposable replay owner is postgres. Runtime/legacy/worker roles get no direct DML.

tables.name: hub.account_content_scope

tables.name: hub.content_bu_run

tables.name: hub.content_bu_membership
tables.semantics: Exact eight source columns plus run_id; no inferred mapping, prefix stripping, or null normalization.

tables.name: hub.content_bu_handover
checks: closed_at IS NULL OR closed_at >= started_at

tables.name: hub.content_bu_membership_interval
checks: valid_to IS NULL OR valid_to >= valid_from
